title: AI Assistant Yuanbao Enhances Image Understanding Capabilities, Covering All-Scenario Daily Needs
excerpt: Recently, Tencent's AI assistant "Yuanbao" announced that its image understanding function has been fully upgraded, officially launching a new service scenario
content_html:
Recently, Tencent's AI assistant "Yuanbao" announced that its image understanding function has been fully upgraded, officially launching a new service scenario called "Stay Calm, Take a Photo First." This upgrade focuses on optimizing text recognition accuracy, detail perception ability, and cross-domain interpretation logic, supporting "image-based Q&A" for multiple daily scenarios such as medical health, life maintenance, contract review, social communication, and content creation, providing users with timely and reliable decision-making references.

According to the official introduction, the upgraded Yuanbao can now accurately recognize professional documents such as medical reports and drug instructions, quickly interpret the meaning of abnormal indicators, and sort out medication contraindications, helping users establish a basic understanding before seeing a doctor; for frequently used documents such as rental contracts and labor contracts, the system can automatically extract key clauses and indicate potential risks, reducing the likelihood of ordinary users being scammed. In daily scenarios, users can take photos of faulty home appliances to get initial troubleshooting guidance, and upload chat screenshots to generate high-empathy response scripts, solving social awkwardness.

In addition, this feature also supports matching personalized copy for casually taken landscape and portrait photos, meeting content creation needs.

Currently, users can download the Yuanbao APP or add a Yuanbao account on WeChat to experience the related services. The official stated that in the future, they will continue to expand the vertical scenarios of image understanding, further reduce the usage barriers of AI tools, and make technology truly serve the "small troubles" of daily life.

content_html_zh:
近日，腾讯AI助手“元宝”宣布图像理解功能全面升级，正式推出“冷静，先拍照”的新服务场景。 本次升级重点优化文本识别准确率、细节感知能力、跨域解读逻辑，支持医疗健康、生命维护、合同审核、社交沟通、内容创作等多个日常场景的“图像问答”，为用户提供及时可靠的决策参考。

据官方介绍，升级后的元宝现可准确识别医疗报告、药品说明书等专业文件，快速解读异常指标含义，梳理用药禁忌，帮助用户在就诊前建立基本了解；对于租赁合同、劳动合同等常用文件，系统可以自动提取关键条款并提示潜在风险，降低普通用户上当受骗的可能性。 在日常场景中，用户可以通过拍摄有故障的家电照片来获得初步的故障排除指导，并上传聊天截图以生成高同理心的回复脚本，解决社交尴尬。

此外，该功能还支持对随意拍摄的风景、人像照片进行个性化文案匹配，满足内容创作需求。

目前，用户可以下载元宝APP或微信添加元宝账号来体验相关服务。 官方表示，未来他们将不断拓展图像理解的垂直场景，进一步降低AI工具的使用门槛，让科技真正服务于日常生活的“小烦恼”。
